name: 3m Bollinger 2.3x fade
_notes: Rule 2 is the CROSS condition and it is not optional. Without it the strategy
re-fires on every bar price stays outside the band, and your sample becomes
~10 duplicates of the same market moment. That is exactly the bug that made
cooldownMin is the second layer of the same defense.
Mirror this for the long side by flipping band->lower, cmp-> < / >=, side->long.
